technicalCoaching.title: Technical coaching for software development teams
technicalCoaching.description: Is your team piling up bugs and technical debt, or depending on a few key people? A technical coach joins your team and works alongside them on day-to-day tasks, transferring quality practices without slowing down productivity or value delivery.
technicalCoaching.fullDescription: When a development team accumulates technical debt, production bugs or dependency on a few people, a theoretical course is not enough: the way the team works every day has to change. With our technical coaching service, a technical coach joins your team and works alongside them on your real product, applying eXtreme Programming practices such as TDD, refactoring and pair programming. The result: higher-quality code, more frequent deliveries and a more autonomous team that keeps those practices over time, without losing sight of productivity and value delivery.
technicalCoaching.quote: We develop high-performance teams capable of meeting product demand effectively and sustainably

acceleratedProgram.title: Accelerated onboarding program for software teams
acceleratedProgram.description: Cut the time it takes your new hires to become productive. We design a custom program around your company's technologies and practices, with hands-on exercises for each topic to accelerate your team's ramp up.
acceleratedProgram.fullDescription: Every developer who takes months to become productive slows your team down and delays your roadmap. Our accelerated onboarding program prepares your new hires to work with your company's technologies, architecture and practices. We design a custom learning plan, convey the concepts as clearly as possible and back it with hands-on exercises for each topic, so your team reaches its delivery pace sooner.
acceleratedProgram.quote: We train software teams by delivering a customized learning plan, adjusted to your company's needs and technologies, with technical coaches with more than 10 years in the industry

ctoAsService.title: CTO as a Service (fractional CTO) for companies
ctoAsService.description: Do you need to define or redefine your company's technology strategy, or validate which technologies are right for your products? We act as your external CTO on key decisions, without the commitment of a full-time hire.
ctoAsService.fullDescription: If your company needs to define or redefine its technology strategy but doesn't have an internal CTO, or you want an external perspective to validate your decisions, our CTO as a Service is for you. We analyze your tech stack, processes and team to design a clear roadmap, select optimal technologies for your products and establish a sustainable growth strategy. We act as your external CTO on key decisions, without the commitment of a full-time hire.
ctoAsService.quote: We help technology companies develop an effective strategy that allows them to grow quickly and sustainably over time, creating technological components that fit their objectives.

softwareConsulting.title: Software consulting for companies
softwareConsulting.description: We find out what is holding back your current software, also analyze your development methodology and help you improve both step by step, with an iterative plan prioritized by impact so you can evolve your product.
softwareConsulting.fullDescription: Is legacy code preventing your company from evolving its product at the pace it needs? In our software consulting engagements we conduct a thorough review of your code, architecture and development processes to identify the critical points limiting your growth. We design an iterative improvement plan with actions prioritized by impact, and accompany you during execution to ensure each improvement is properly implemented. We work with you, not for you.
softwareConsulting.quote: We help software companies solve technical problems that prevent efficiently achieving the software's objective

training.title: Training for software development teams
training.description: We have a wide variety of customized courses aimed at putting into practice what you really need in your day-to-day, executing the course in the most proactive way to speed up learning and implementation of knowledge.
training.fullDescription: We offer a wide variety of customized courses focused on putting into practice what you really need in your day-to-day work. We deliver training in TDD, Clean Code, software architecture, Next.js, design patterns, DDD, and much more. All our courses are highly practical (over 70% hands-on time) and are taught in small groups to ensure personalized attention. Every course is tailored to your team's specific needs and technology stack.
training.quote: We train your team with practical, customized courses that guarantee immediate application of knowledge

courses.title: Training
courses.subtitle: Courses designed for teams seeking excellence
courses.subtitle1: We have a wide variety of customized courses aimed at putting into practice what you really need in your day-to-day.

legacyCode.title: Legacy Code
legacyCode.description: If adding features to your application, following technology trends, or even updating dependencies becomes a headache for your team, this course is perfect for you. In this course we will learn advanced techniques for working with legacy code while starting to eliminate those pieces that have a high level of coupling that prevent us from evolving our software

frontendArchitecture.title: Frontend Architecture
frontendArchitecture.description: When we work on large projects, we all know the challenge of adding new features and maintaining current ones, all without bugs. For this, we have created this course, where we will learn how to implement a sustainable React architecture that allows us to add features much faster and easier, without so much effort.

designPatterns.title: Design Patterns
designPatterns.description: Design patterns are the key to creating software that evolves easily and with reasonable effort over a long time. Patterns not only allow us to have elegant designs, but also unify the way of working across different development teams.

cleanCode.title: Clean Code
cleanCode.description: Do you want to learn the definitive techniques that will allow you to have clearer, self-explanatory and easier to maintain code? In this course we will explain everything you need to know, but as we always do, this course has a high volume of practice.

nextJs.title: Next.js
nextJs.description: Next.js gives you the best React.js development experience with all the features you need for production like Client Side Rendering, Server Side Rendering, Static Site Generation (SSG) and even automatic production deployments with Vercel.

ddd.title: Domain Driven Design
ddd.description: Having trouble designing your domain and creating useful unit tests? DDD can help make your code expressive and modular - perfect for unit testing!

tdd.title: Test-Driven Development
tdd.description: Also known as TDD (test-driven development) is a programming practice that consists of writing tests first (usually unit tests) and then writing the source code that passes the test satisfactorily and, finally, refactoring the written code.

react.title: React with TypeScript
react.description: Learn everything you need to create enterprise applications using React, one of the most widely used Frontend libraries in the entire world. We will ensure that your team acquires the professional competencies necessary to build high-quality software.

oop.title: Object-Oriented Design
oop.description: We all know how important it is to master object-oriented programming. For this, we propose to explain in a clear, simple way and as we usually do with lots and lots of practice how to design in the best way using the object-oriented programming paradigm.
